claim: All defects found in this audit are handled, each with a regression test that fails on the old code. This is not a claim that no bugs remain.

defects.title: Two competing reward implementations; internal one used the superseded provisional formula
defects.discovered_by: 11 published reward vectors run against scoring/reward.py
defects.root_cause: Phase 6 provisional reward module never retired after the official scorer landed in RC-004; no test pinned the two together
defects.impact: All internal reward-derived artifacts published numbers the jury would not reproduce; negative rewards impossible; empty-truth P/R wrong

defects.title: Cursor tokens unusable for ~6.5% of offsets (delimiter byte inside random HMAC signature)
defects.discovered_by: walking official fixture L (214-row ledger) at limit=50
defects.root_cause: token = raw || b'.' || sig, split with rsplit(b'.',1); ~6.5% of 16-byte signatures contain 0x2E
defects.impact: Rows 200-213 of the L fixture ledger unreachable; official C05 would fail
defects.artifact_consequence: trajectories.jsonl regenerated; verified only cursor tokens changed, metrics identical

defects.title: Trailing base64 garbage accepted: token + 'x' decoded to original bytes and passed HMAC check
defects.discovered_by: existing tamper test failing once BUG-TL-0002 was fixed
defects.root_cause: decode verified the HMAC of decoded bytes but never that the token was their canonical encoding
defects.impact: Tamper evidence was weaker than documented; the old test passed by luck

defects.title: Official C05 test walked only invoices, missing the table that needs a fourth page
defects.root_cause: test mirrored the wording 'three pages' and stopped at the minimum instead of checking every table
defects.impact: A P0 shipping defect was invisible to the official suite

limitations: Docker-based verification not executed (no docker binary in the audit environment)
Kernel-level isolation strength not measured against a hostile escape attempt
No penetration test; security attack list is requirement-driven
canary_fuzz PASS is a measured negative, not a proof across all encodings
Property tests are seeded, not exhaustive; hypothesis optional and skipped
Frozen configs/scoring/default.json still carries the unused eta=0.05 key (D-18-01)
scoring/reward.py remains as a compatibility shim over official_scorer
tzdata drift across machines not measured
Jury hardware timing is not ours to measure
